subtitle: Keys let AI tools (MCP) read or act on the bot for you.
limitReached: You have used all {max} keys. Revoke one or wait for it to expire to create another.
empty: No keys yet. Create one to connect an AI tool.

form.title: Create an API key
form.name: Key name
form.namePlaceholder: For example: Claude on my laptop
form.nameTooLong: The name can have at most {max} characters.
form.modeReadHelp: Can look at data but change nothing.
form.modeWriteHelp: Can change data. Lasts at most {max} days and can only be created right after you sign in.
form.expiresRange: Enter a number of days from 1 to {max}.
form.invalid: The key details are not valid. Check them and try again.

secret.title: Your key is ready
secret.warning: This is the only time the key is shown. Copy it and keep it somewhere safe: once you close this window you cannot see it again.
secret.label: API key
secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the key and copy it by hand.

revoke.title: Revoke the key “{name}”?
revoke.body: The key stops working at once. Scheduled messages this key created that have not run yet are cancelled.

connect.title: How to connect
connect.intro: In your AI tool, add an MCP server with the address below and send the key in the Authorization header. Keep the key in the SAB_MCP_KEY environment variable and never write it into a file.
